climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A New Jersey AVA of 2.25 million acres covering the state's eastern and southernmost regions, including the Atlantic coastline. It is one of five physiographic regions of New Jersey and contains the Cape May Peninsula AVA.
